thread:
sam: Heads up, promote is blocked. Multiple linux runners failing to extract wheel -> unexpected EOF. Also seeing a smoke test flake pinned to axis user-seed=42.

lina: yikes. which job? paste the error?

sam: build-wheel:linux.manylinux2014 x86_64. log snippet: 
```
+ python -m pip install dist/my_service-2.0.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
Processing ./dist/my_service-2.0.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
error: incomplete read (0 bytes read)
"Unexpected EOF" during wheel installation
```

ci-agent: Verified: 4 runners showed the same extraction EOF. Artifact size on storage node differs from uploader's local file size (uploader: 12,345,678 bytes, storage: 11,987,654 bytes).

lina: that suggests a truncated upload. Could be multipart shard missing. Any S3 errors in uploader?

sam: uploader job logs show 200 OK, but multipart complete step shows warn about missing parts for a short window. We replicate to mirror A and B; mirror B has OBJECT_TRUNCATED entries around 1745559600.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked by artifact-integrity-check. Suggested fallback: manual pin to image registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-04-07-09 or wait for reupload. Change window closes in 2h.

lina: We need a quick decision. If we rerun uploader now it might succeed but could block the change window. Pinning keeps schedule and we can hotfix later.

infra-oncall: I'm investigating mirror B. Early telemetry: one of the storage nodes OOM'd during garbage collection and returned truncated objects for ~3m. We're doing object repair/rehydration.

sam: Another factor: smoke test failure (user-seed=42) times out after 120s during onboarding check; correlated with slow pip install (stall on extraction) on those runners. So artifact issue likely causes the flake.

lina: Ok decision: pin to last-known-good image for promote and create follow-up: reupload artifact, rerun full matrix after cut, and add preflight artifact checksum verification in pipeline. I'll draft the release notes note.

deploy-bot: Action applied: require_manual_approval=true; pin_image=registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-04-07-09; hold_reason="truncated-wheel + smoke user-seed=42".

ci-agent: small mitigation PR suggestion: add step before pip install: curl -sSfL "${ARTIFACT_URL}" -o /tmp/art && echo "$(sha256sum /tmp/art | cut -d' ' -f1)" > /tmp/art.sha && test "$(cat /tmp/art.sha)" = "${EXPECTED_SHA}" || exit 1

lina: please open that PR, tag me. I'll approve manual promote once PM confirms no critical product blockers in this cut.

infra-oncall: Incident INC-2026-058 opened and assigned to infra-storage. Root cause provisional: GC race causing partial object re-writes. Recovery ETA ~45m for mirror repairs.

sam: thanks. summary: pin to last-good image to unblock change window, incident INC-2026-058 for truncated objects, follow-ups: reupload artifact + rerun matrix, add checksum preflight.

lina: +1

ci-agent: will queue reupload attempt and provide PR link for checksum step.
